# Fixtures

Representative *pre-ACM* user config files for the tier-1 agents, shaped by each agent's
official documentation (see `docs/ACM_Agent_Support_Matrix_opus-5.5.md`) and containing the
non-managed content real users have: hooks, permissions, MCP servers, comments, project trust
tables. They are the corpus for the format-layer tests and the input for adapter golden tests.

They are synthesised, not copied from real machines. When a real (redacted) sample shows a
shape these miss, add it here — fixtures double as upstream-schema-drift sentinels.
